narr: Isolated thunderstorms moved northwest across parts of Graham, Cochise, Pinal and Pima counties during the afternoon and evening. Sporadic wind damage and isolated flash flooding occurred in the Tucson Metro area.
ev: Heavy rain of 1-1.5 in less than 1 hour caused Roger Wash to flow rapidly across Silverbell Rd. between West Hills of Gold and Sweetwater Drives.
Heavy rain of 1-2 in less than an hour caused the closure of sections of Mission Rd. from Drexel to Campus Dr.
lsr: Mission Rd. between Valencia and Drexel closed due to flooding.
Silverbell Rd south of Camino Del Cerro.
